sections.1.heading.context: Section 1 heading (H2) — the question a buyer asks

en.text: What decides what a website costs?

sections.1.answer.context: Section 1 answer, directly under its heading (self-contained, 40-60 words)

en.text: The main drivers are the number of pages, the features you need, whether the design is custom or built from a template, how much content has to be written or prepared, and whether you need an online store. A simple site with a few pages costs less than a larger site with a shop and custom features.

en.text: Are there running costs after the website is built?

sections.5.answer.context: Section 5 answer, directly under its heading (self-contained, 40-60 words)

en.text: A website usually has running costs after launch, such as the domain name and hosting, whoever builds it. Ask any provider which of these are included in the price and which you pay separately, and get the answer in writing before you agree to anything.
